name: n8n-code-javascript
description: Write JavaScript in n8n Code nodes using `$input`/`$json`/`$node`, `$helpers`, DateTime, and `$jmespath()`.

Choose "Run Once for All Items" mode (recommended for most use cases): use `$input.all()`/`items`; once regardless of input count; best for aggregation, filtering, batch processing, transformations, and API calls. Choose "Run Once for Each Item" only for independent per-item logic: use `$input.item`/`$item`; slower for large datasets. Not sure? Use "All Items" mode (you can always loop inside).

Access: `$input.all()`, `$input.first()`, `$input.item`; specific nodes: `$node["Webhook"].json`. **CRITICAL**: Must return `[{json: {...}}]` format. **CRITICAL RULE**: Always return array of objects with `json` property. Webhook data is under `$json.body` (not `$json` directly): use `$json.body.name` or `$input.first().json.body`.

Use JavaScript directly (no `{{ }}`); use template literals: `` `${value}` ``. Use optional chaining/guard clauses for missing fields. Prefer map/filter/reduce; filter before expensive transformations. Log with `console.log()` for debugging.

HTTP:
const response = await $helpers.httpRequest({url: 'https://api.example.com/data'});
return [{json: {data: response}}];

Dates: `DateTime.now()`, `.toFormat()`, `.toISO()`, `.plus()`, `.minus()`. Queries: `$jmespath(data, 'users[?age >= \`18\`]')`.

Use Code for complex transformations, calculations, parsing, conditionals, and aggregation. Use **Set** for simple field mapping, **Filter** for basic filtering, **IF**/**Switch** for simple conditionals, and **HTTP Request** for HTTP requests only.

Before deploying Code nodes, verify:
[ ] **Code is not empty** - Must have meaningful logic
[ ] **Return statement exists** - Must return array of objects
[ ] **Proper return format** - Each item: `{json: {...}}`
[ ] **Data access correct** - Using `$input.all()`, `$input.first()`, or `$input.item`
[ ] **No n8n expressions** - Use JavaScript template literals: `` `${value}` ``
[ ] **Error handling** - Guard clauses for null/undefined inputs
[ ] **Webhook data** - Access via `.body` if from webhook
[ ] **Mode selection** - "All Items" for most cases
[ ] **Performance** - Prefer map/filter over manual loops
[ ] **Output consistent** - All code paths return same structure

n8n MCP Tools Expert:
`search_nodes({query: "code"})`
`get_node_essentials("nodes-base.code")`
`validate_node_operation()`

References: [DATA_ACCESS.md](DATA_ACCESS.md), [COMMON_PATTERNS.md](COMMON_PATTERNS.md), [ERROR_PATTERNS.md](ERROR_PATTERNS.md), [BUILTIN_FUNCTIONS.md](BUILTIN_FUNCTIONS.md), https://docs.n8n.io/code/code-node/
